en.bdb: One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor
One Oankar, the primal energy, realized through the grace of divine preceptor

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸਚਾ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਚੁ ਖੰਡੁ ਵਸਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: satigur sachaa paatisaahu saadhasa(n)gat sach kha(n)dd vasaiaa|

en.bdb: The true Guru is true emperor who has founded the abode of truth in the form of the congregation of the saints.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਹੋਇ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ਨ ਆਪੁ ਗਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gur sikh lai gursikh hoi aap gavai na aap ganaiaa|

en.bdb: The Sikhs living there being taught by the Guru, lose their ego and never make themselves noticed.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਭੋ ਸਾਧਨਾ ਸਾਧਿ ਸਧਾਇ ਸਾਧੁ ਸਦਵਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gursikh sabho saadhanaa saadh sadhai saadh sadhavaiaa|

en.bdb: The Sikhs of the Guru get themselves called sadhus only after accomplishing all sorts of discipline.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚਹੁ ਵਰਣਾ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਦੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਦਾਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: chahu varanaa upadhes dhe maiaa vich udhaas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: They preach to all the four varnas and themselves remain indifferent in the midst of maya.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਚਹੁ ਓਰੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਹੁ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰ ਮੰਤੁ ਦਿੜਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sachahu orai sabh kih sach naau gur ma(n)t dhiRaiaa|

en.bdb: They explain clearly that everything is below truth i.e. the truth is highest and only this mantra should be recited with deep integrity.

verses.gurmukhi: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਭ ਕੋ ਮੰਨੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: hukamai a(n)dhar sabh ko ma(n)nai hukamu su sach samaiaa|

en.bdb: Everything is subsumed in the divine order and whosoever bows his head before His order, merges in the truth.
The consciousness attuned to the Word makes man competent to behold the invisible Lord.
